versions.changelog:
UIBC Race Operations Team (uibc-race-ops) – Initial Release

- Introduced a standing six-member AI contest operations team with clear roles: race director, problem design, judging governance, contestant operations, communications, and enterprise partnerships.
- Embedded governance guardrails for season planning, problem authoring, judging, community ops, leaderboard release, sponsorships, and dispute handling.
- Provided detailed protocols and division of duties to ensure credibility, contest fairness, and accumulation of operational expertise.
- Released bilingual documentation (English & Chinese) outlining standard workflows, deliverable templates, and mandatory red-line compliance.
- Defined scope, capabilities, and interface for use across major platforms with no external permissions required.
